105,000 (expected) | coordinates = {{coord|41|22|51.2|N|2|07|22.2|E|display=inline,title}} | chrtitle = President | chairman = [[Joan Laporta]] | mgrtitle = Head coach | manager = [[Hansi Flick]] | league = {{Spanish football updater|Barcelona}} | season = {{Spanish football updater|Barcelona2}} | position = {{Spanish football updater|Barcelona3}} | current = 2026–27 FC Barcelona season | website = {{URL|https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/|fcbarcelona.com}} | pattern_la1 = _barcelona2627h | pattern_b1 = _barcelona2627h | pattern_ra1 = _barcelona2627h | pattern_sh1 = _barcelona2627h | pattern_so1 = | leftarm1 = 05003B | body1 = 05003B | rightarm1 = 05003B | shorts1 = 05003B | socks1 = 05003B | pattern_la2 = _barcelona2627a | pattern_b2 = _barcelona2627a | pattern_ra2 = _barcelona2627a | pattern_sh2 = _barcelona2627a | pattern_so2 = | leftarm2 = 000000 | body2 = 000000 | rightarm2 = 000000 | shorts2 = 7F20E0 | socks2 = 000000 | pattern_la3 = _barcelona2627t | pattern_b3 = _barcelona2627t | pattern_ra3 = _barcelona2627t | pattern_sh3 = _barcelona2627t | pattern_so3 = _barcelona2627tl | leftarm3 = 88D9D3 | body3 = 88D9D3 | rightarm3 = 03B7C6 | shorts3 = 89DAD4 | socks3 = 88D9D3 }} {{FC Barcelona sections}} '''Futbol Club Barcelona''' ({{IPA|ca|fudˈbɔl ˈklub bəɾsəˈlonə|-|Futbol Club Barcelona - name.ogg}}), commonly known as '''FC Barcelona''' and colloquially as '''Barça''' ({{IPA|ca|ˈbaɾsə|}}), is a professional [[Football club (association football)|football club]] based in [[Barcelona]], Catalonia, Spain, that competes in [[La Liga]], the top division of [[Spanish football league system|Spanish football]]. Founded in 1899 by a group of Swiss, Catalan, German, and English footballers led by [[Joan Gamper]], the club has become a symbol of Catalan culture and [[Catalanism]], hence the motto ''Més que un club'' ("More than a club").{{cite web|url=https://arxiu.fcbarcelona.cat/web/catala/club/club_avui/mes_que_un_club/mesqueunclub_historia.html|title=Més que un club: UNA DIVISA HISTÒRICA|work=FC Barcelona|language=ca|access-date=23 February 2026|archive-date=10 January 2014|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140110093041/http://arxiu.fcbarcelona.cat/web/catala/club/club_avui/mes_que_un_club/mesqueunclub_historia.html|url-status=dead}} Unlike many other football clubs, [[Supporters of FC Barcelona|the supporters]] own and operate Barcelona. It is the third-most valuable football club in the world, worth $5.6 billion, and the [[Deloitte Football Money League|world's fourth richest]] football club in terms of revenue, with an annual turnover of €800.1 million.{{cite magazine|first1=Mike|first2=Justin|last1=Ozanian|last2=Teitelbaum|title=The World's Most Valuable Soccer Teams 2024 |url=https://www.forbes.com/sites/mikeozanian/2024/05/23/the-worlds-most-valuable-soccer-teams-2024/|date=23 May 2024|magazine=[[Forbes]]|access-date=31 October 2024|url-status=live|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230531165703/https://www.forbes.com/lists/soccer-valuations/?sh=5bcddd51198b|archive-date=31 May 2023}}{{cite web|url=https://www2.deloitte.com/uk/en/pages/sports-business-group/articles/deloitte-football-money-league.html|title=Deloitte Football Money League 2024|date=February 2024|publisher=[[Deloitte]]|access-date=9 February 2024|archive-date=20 January 2017|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170120033918/https://www2.deloitte.com/uk/en/pages/sports-business-group/articles/deloitte-football-money-league.html|url-status=live}} The official Barcelona anthem is the "[[Cant del Barça]]", written by {{ill|Jaume Picas i Guiu|ca}} and [[Josep Maria Espinàs]].{{cite web|url=https://www.fcbarcelona.com/club/identity/card/the-anthems|title=The history of the Barça anthems|publisher=FC Barcelona|access-date=24 September 2017|archive-date=3 October 2017|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20171003231932/https://www.fcbarcelona.com/club/identity/card/the-anthems|url-status=live}} Barcelona traditionally play in dark shades of blue and [[Shades of red#Garnet|garnet]] stripes, hence nicknamed ''Blaugrana''. Barcelona are one of the [[List of football clubs by competitive honours won|world's most decorated clubs]]. Domestically, Barcelona has won a record 82 trophies: 29 [[La Liga]], 32 [[Copa del Rey]], 2 [[Copa de la Liga]], 16 [[Supercopa de España]] and 3 [[Copa Eva Duarte]] titles, as well as being the record holder for the latter four competitions. In [[FC Barcelona in international football|international club football]], Barça has won 22 European and worldwide titles: five [[UEFA Champions League]] titles, a record four [[UEFA Cup Winners' Cup]]s, a record three [[Inter-Cities Fairs Cup]]s, five [[UEFA Super Cup]]s, a joint record two [[Latin Cup]]s and three [[FIFA Club World Cup]]s.{{cite web|url=http://en.archive.uefa.com/footballeurope/club=50080/domestic.html |title=Football Europe: FC Barcelona |publisher=[[UEFA]] |access-date=4 May 2009 |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20100603054639/http://en.archive.uefa.com/footballeurope/club%3D50080/domestic.html |archive-date= 3 June 2010 }}{{cite web |url=https://www.fifa.com/classicfootball/clubs/club=1903416/index.html|archive-date=29 April 2015|url-status=dead|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150429022457/https://www.fifa.com/classicfootball/clubs/club=1903416/index.html|title=Classic Football: Clubs: FC Barcelona |website=[[FIFA|FIFA.com]]|publisher=Fédération Internationale de Football Association|access-date=29 April 2015}}{{cite news|last=Rimet|first=Pierre|date=4 January 1951|title=Cartas de Paris - Das pirâmides do Egito ao colosso do Maracanã, com o Sr. Jules Rimet|trans-title=Letters from Paris - From the pyramids of Egypt to the colossus of Maracanã, with Mr. Jules Rimet|url=http://memoria.bn.gov.br/DocReader/112518_01/38281|editor-last=Rodrigues Filho|editor-first=Mário|editor-link=Mário Filho|work=[[Jornal dos Sports]]|language=pt|issue=6554|location=Rio de Janeiro, Brazil|page=5|access-date=2 June 2017|quote=A Taça Latina é uma competição criada pela F. I. F. A. a pedido dos quatro países que a disputam atualmente. Mas o Regulamento é feito por uma Comissão composta por membros das Federações concorrentes e de fato a F. I. F. A. não participa ativamente na organização|archive-date=6 June 2020|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200606201515/http://memoria.bn.br/docreader/DocReader.aspx?bib=112518_01&pagfis=38281|url-status=live}} Barcelona was ranked first in the [[International Federation of Football History & Statistics]] Club World Ranking for 1997, 2009, 2011, 2012 and 2015, and occupies the ninth position on the [[UEFA coefficient#Men's club coefficient|UEFA club rankings]] {{As of|2023|May|lc=y}}.{{cite web | url=http://www.iffhs.de/former-results/ | title=Former Results | publisher=International Federation of Football History & Statistics | access-date=16 December 2014 | archive-date=15 June 2018 | archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180615214702/https://iffhs.de/former-results/ | url-status=live }}{{cite web | url=http://iffhs.de/club-world-ranking-2015/ | title=Club World Ranking 2015 | publisher=International Federation of Football History & Statistics | access-date=7 January 2015 | archive-date=11 August 2019 | archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190811225147/https://iffhs.de/club-world-ranking-2015/ | url-status=live }}{{cite web |title=UEFA Club Coefficients |url=https://www.uefa.com/nationalassociations/uefarankings/club/ |access-date=7 May 2023 |publisher=[[UEFA]] |archive-date=20 March 2017 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170320224158/http://www.uefa.com/memberassociations/uefarankings/club/index.html |url-status=live }} The club has a long-standing rivalry with [[Real Madrid CF|Real Madrid]], and matches between the two teams are referred to as ''[[El Clásico]]''. Barcelona is one of the most widely supported teams in the world, and the club has one of the largest social media followings in the world among sports teams.[http://www.marca.com/en/2014/11/13/en/football/barcelona/1415913827.html "Barça, the most loved club in the world"] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20141114222009/http://www.marca.com/en/2014/11/13/en/football/barcelona/1415913827.html |date=14 November 2014 }}. ''Marca''. Madrid. Retrieved 15 December 2014.{{cite news|title=Barcelona wins Social Star Award for 'Most Popular Sports Team' |url=http://www.straitstimes.com/the-big-story/social-media-awards/story/social-star-awards-2013-list-winners-20130523 |work=The Straits Times |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20131103223605/http://www.straitstimes.com/the-big-story/social-media-awards/story/social-star-awards-2013-list-winners-20130523 |archive-date=3 November 2013 }} [[List of FC Barcelona players|Barcelona players]] have won a joint record twelve [[Ballon d'Or]] awards, with recipients including [[Johan Cruyff]], as well as a record six [[FIFA World Player of the Year]] awards, with winners including [[Romário]], [[Ronaldo (Brazilian footballer)|Ronaldo]], [[Rivaldo]], [[Ronaldinho]] and [[Lionel Messi]]. Barcelona! |url=http://mag.newsweek.com/2011/06/03/is-barcelona-the-greatest-soccer-team-ever.html |work=Newsweek |date=25 October 2015 |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160304211416/http://mag.newsweek.com/2011/06/03/is-barcelona-the-greatest-soccer-team-ever.html |archive-date=4 March 2016}} By winning their fifth Champions League trophy in [[2015 UEFA Champions League Final|2015]] under [[Luis Enrique]], Barcelona became the first European football club in history to achieve the continental treble twice.{{cite web|url=https://www.lavanguardia.com/deportes/futbol/20150606/54432668213/barca-record-primero-dos-tripletes-europa.html|title=Un Barça de récord, el primero en lograr dos tripletes en Europa|date=6 June 2015|work=[[La Vanguardia]]|access-date=25 May 2023|language=es-ES|url-status=live|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230525171656/https://www.lavanguardia.com/deportes/futbol/20150606/54432668213/barca-record-primero-dos-tripletes-europa.html?facet=amp|archive-date= 25 May 2023}}"}}
